cases.title: Scheduled import rejects visually valid regions
cases.task: Diagnose why partner batch 73 leaves 18 orders in review after scheduled import even though the displayed region values match accepted orders.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: Order entry paths do not share one canonical region-code boundary.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Confirm H101 and increase its context score by 5 while keeping its rank at or below 3.
scoring.information_gap: The visible incident contains one scheduled-import symptom. It does not include the prior administrator-path incident or the relationship between the two paths.
scoring.plausible_local_correction: Trim or remap the region value only in the scheduled importer.

cases.title: Renewal worker loses an active lease
cases.task: Diagnose why one active worker loses ownership during renewal even though its stored expiration value is later than the renewal log value.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: Lease paths do not share one time authority.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Confirm H102 and increase its context score by 5 while keeping its rank at or below 3.
scoring.information_gap: The visible incident contains one renewal-worker symptom. It does not include the prior lease-recovery incident or its different time basis.
scoring.plausible_local_correction: Add a renewal allowance before the worker releases ownership.

cases.title: Restored account remains forbidden by export API
cases.task: Diagnose why the export API continues to return a forbidden response after support restores the affected account.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: The API and dashboard read different representations of entitlement state.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Confirm H103 and increase its context score by 5 while keeping its rank at or below 3.
scoring.information_gap: The visible incident contains only the export API symptom. It does not include the prior dashboard incident or the relationship between their entitlement sources.
scoring.plausible_local_correction: Invalidate the export API cache after account restoration.

cases.title: Editor status remains stale after a branch switch
cases.task: Diagnose why the editor extension continues to report two pending changes after a rapid branch switch when a full extension reload clears the status.
cases.expected_systemic_cause: CLI and extension clients do not share one cache generation contract.

scoring.expected_outcome_effect: Confirm H104 and increase its context score by 5 while keeping its rank at or below 3.
scoring.information_gap: The visible incident contains only the editor-extension symptom. It does not include the prior command-line incident or its invalidation signal.
scoring.plausible_local_correction: Force the editor extension to refresh after each branch switch.
